subject: Scaling CBCT infra & tooling at Videa
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

Saw the recent progress at Videa - 30+ FDA-cleared detections and expansion into paediatric DSOs suggests the team is thinking seriously about scaling model coverage and clinical breadth. As that grows, I imagine infrastructure, data workflows, and regulatory iteration cycles are becoming increasingly central to your ML approach. 

I lead the medical imaging team at Encord - we're working with teams like Philips and Overjet to support CBCT labeling, model training, and audit tooling for FDA-submission-grade pipelines. Curious how you're approaching things like multi-modality, dataset expansion, or internal tooling for new algorithm development. 

Would be great to trade notes if you're up for a quick 20-min chat - Tuesdays/Thursdays generally work well on my end.

subject: Encord & Anduril - CVPR Connect
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the recent raise! Will you be at the Anduril CVPR booth this
year?

I'd love to introduce myself in person. We work w/ many AI-driven
autonomous drone co's such as Skydio & Zipline who are developing very
similar computer vision models to Anduril for the purpose of object
detection, tracking etc. - I hope we can find time to connect.

For context, Encord is a computer vision ML DataOps platform (Series B,
$50m raised). The companies mentioned leverage our platform to improve
their model performance (via higher quality training data) & to speed up
their expansion into new use cases/environments through improved end-to-end
data pipeline automation & labelling efficiency (2-10x vs. in-house/first
gen tools) resulting in faster model iteration cycles.

Would you be open to a coffee & exchange perspectives? We'll be at the
conference Friday (6/13) to Sunday (6/15). If virtual is easier, happy to
find a time that suits you!

subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:
Hi [NAME], 

Our Head of AI is hosting an exclusive fireside chat for AI leaders during CVPR with Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, Chief R&D officer at Nexar), followed by an intimate roundtable dinner - & we'd love for you to join us, if you're available.

We've reserved a private dining room for ~20 guests at Moto Cucina - about a 15 min walk from the conference - on Saturday 14th June, starting at 6:30 PM. Would you be interested in joining?
